description: Set whether one control is material (write — ADMIN's own key; a platform key gets 403): true/false with a reason, or null for the catalogue default (material at weighting 10).

material.description: true or false overrides the catalogue default; null clears the override. The admin is recorded as the approver: deciding a control is not material lets it be excluded or marked not_applicable without one

reason.description: Why (max 2000 characters). Required when material is true or false, and when a null clear makes a control weighted below 10 not material (400 otherwise)

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_set_control_materiality
